SELECT l.location_id, l.location_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" l ON o.location_id = l.location_id
GROUP BY l.location_id, l.location_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
